mentions.name: Release Gate
mentions.description: A pre-deployment checker for AI agents that runs inside CI/CD pipelines, requiring no infrastructure beyond a Python environment. It checks AI agents before they go live to catch issues like runaway loops and excessive token usage that inflate costs.
mentions.problem: AI agent cost explosions and excess token usage are typically detected only after deployment; teams lack pre-deployment checks and clarity on responsibility when endless loops slowly raise hidden costs.
mentions.audience: Teams deploying AI agents, including those worried about hidden post-deployment cost overruns
mentions.source_excerpt:
Introducing -  https://release-gate.com/

A pre deployment checker for AI agents that sits in your CI/CD pipeline, No infra required, just a python environment and you are ready to roll.
